mapper.select: select d.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, p.dept_name as parentDeptName, d.province, d.city, d.area, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status from sys_dept d left join sys_dept p on d.parent_id = p.dept_id where d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.del_flag = '0' ${params.dataScope} limit 1

select ( select greatest(count(1) - 1, 0) from sys_dept d where d.del_flag = '0'
${params.dataScope} ) as childDeptCount, ( select count(1) from fe_fire_point f left join sys_dept d on f.dept_id = d.dept_id where (f.del_flag is null or f.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope} ) as firePointCount, ( select count(1) from fe_gateway g left join sys_dept d on g.dept_id = d.dept_id where (g.del_flag is null or g.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope} ) as gatewayCount, ( select count(1) from fe_sensor s left join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id where (s.del_flag is null or s.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope} ) as sensorCount, ( select count(1) from fe_extinguisher e left join sys_dept d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id where (e.del_flag is null or e.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope} ) as extinguisherCount, ( select count(1) from fe_gateway g left join sys_dept d on g.dept_id = d.dept_id where (g.del_flag is null or g.del_flag = '0') and g.fire_point_id is null
${params.dataScope} ) as gatewayUnboundFirePointCount, ( select count(1) from fe_sensor s left join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id where (s.del_flag is null or s.del_flag = '0') and s.gateway_id is null
${params.dataScope} ) as sensorUnboundGatewayCount, ( select count(1) from fe_extinguisher e left join sys_dept d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id where (e.del_flag is null or e.del_flag = '0') and e.sensor_id is null
${params.dataScope} ) as extinguisherUnboundSensorCount, 0 as missingDeptCount

select f.fire_point_id as firePointId, d.dept_name as deptName, f.fire_point_name as firePointName, f.fire_point_code as firePointCode, f.station_type as stationType, f.location, f.building, f.floor, f.expected_extinguisher_count as expectedExtinguisherCount, (select count(1) from fe_extinguisher e where e.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id and (e.del_flag is null or e.del_flag = '0')) as actualExtinguisherCount, (select count(1) from fe_sensor s left join fe_gateway g on s.gateway_id = g.gateway_id where g.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id and (g.del_flag is null or g.del_flag = '0') and (s.del_flag is null or s.del_flag = '0')) as actualSensorCount, f.status from fe_fire_point f left join sys_dept d on f.dept_id = d.dept_id where (f.del_flag is null or f.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope} order by d.dept_name, f.sort_order, f.fire_point_id

select g.gateway_id as gatewayId, g.external_tbox_id as externalTboxId, d.dept_name as deptName, f.fire_point_name as firePointName, g.imei, g.sim, g.status, g.last_online_time as lastOnlineTime, g.last_sync_time as lastSyncTime from fe_gateway g left join sys_dept d on g.dept_id = d.dept_id left join fe_fire_point f on g.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id where (g.del_flag is null or g.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope} order by d.dept_name, f.sort_order, g.gateway_id

select s.sensor_id as sensorId, d.dept_name as deptName, f.fire_point_name as firePointName, s.sensor_code as sensorCode, coalesce(g.imei, s.gateway_code) as gatewayCode, s.pressure, s.temperature, s.battery_level as batteryLevel, s.status, s.last_online_time as lastOnlineTime, s.last_sync_time as lastSyncTime from fe_sensor s left join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id left join fe_gateway g on s.gateway_id = g.gateway_id left join fe_fire_point f on g.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id where (s.del_flag is null or s.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope} order by d.dept_name, f.sort_order, s.sensor_id

select e.extinguisher_id as extinguisherId, d.dept_name as deptName, f.fire_point_name as firePointName, e.label_code as labelCode, e.product_name as productName, e.specification, e.extinguisher_type as extinguisherType, e.extinguisher_form as extinguisherForm, coalesce(s.sensor_code, e.sensor_code) as sensorCode, e.production_date as productionDate, e.expiry_date as expiryDate, e.status, e.last_sync_time as lastSyncTime from fe_extinguisher e left join sys_dept d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id left join fe_fire_point f on e.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id left join fe_sensor s on e.sensor_id = s.sensor_id where (e.del_flag is null or e.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope} order by d.dept_name, f.sort_order, e.extinguisher_id
